name: APK packages
description: Installs a list of system packages with apk from the repositories the Alpine Linux image already configures.

packages.description: Comma-separated packages to install: name, name=version, name~version, a range such as name>=version, name@tag, or a provided name such as cmd:jq. Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored; an empty list installs nothing.

refreshPolicy.description: Select native default refresh, check every repository, or require cached metadata without refreshing.

cleanup.description: Remove all managed caches, package files only, or skip feature cleanup. Native retention remains independent.

networkTimeout.description: Native network timeout in seconds (1–3600), or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.

upgradePackages.description: Request upgrades of listed packages and their dependencies with apk add, preserving world constraints.
